claim_text: The GPT-5.6 family is three tiers: Sol the flagship, Terra a balanced model for everyday work, and Luna the most cost-efficient model.
evidence_span: our new flagship, **Sol**, alongside **Terra**, a balanced model for everyday work, and **Luna**, our most cost-efficient model.

claim_text: On Agents' Last Exam, a benchmark of long-running professional workflows across 55 fields, OpenAI reports GPT-5.6 Sol at 53.6, 13.1 points above Claude Fable 5, and 11.4 points above it even at medium effort at about a quarter of the estimated cost.
evidence_span: GPT‑5.6 Sol sets a new high of 53.6, eclipsing Claude Fable 5 (adaptive reasoning) by 13.1 points. Even at medium reasoning, it beats Fable 5 by 11.4 points at roughly one-quarter the estimated cost.
